card.name: Words leading into a year or date
card.fires_on: The word just before a year or date value, such as "of" after a month name, "Date" in a label like Review Date, or "when" in who-what-when. Also the dash in a year range.

modes.label: "of" after month
modes.description: The word "of" between a month name and a four-digit year.

modes.label: Date labels
modes.description: The word "Date" in a table header or review/update line, right before the date itself.
modes.example: - Reviewer: Michael J. Fucci, DO - Review Date: 09/2012 - - Update<< Date>>: 00/91/

modes.label: Who-what-when and year ranges
modes.description: The word "when" in the list who, what, when, and the dash in a school-year range.

card.writes: It pushes toward time-span words such as century and year (cent, 世纪, 年度), and away from age endings like -old.
card.plain: It fires on the small word right before a year or date is written.
